proposal.reason: Main change is a CI pipeline overhaul: daily/source-sanity workflows now generate test inputs from JSON families, expand node-group scheduling (including cross-rack handling), add artifact integrity/cache probe+publish logic, and produce/upload a performance workbook from reconciled run logs. The added/removed xtest scripts, manifests, and legacy CSV inputs are all supporting CI execution, reconciliation, and reporting behavior rather than PCCL runtime modules.
